series: AI FROM ZERO TO FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
notes: Keys: n=episode number, t=title, lvl=curriculum level (0-11), p=prerequisite episode numbers, c=concept, w=why it matters here, s=one-sentence story idea, d=est. seconds, fv=true if it contains product/protocol-specific claims that MUST be verified against official docs before scripting, pilot=pilot letter. All episodes start at status IDEA.

seasons.name: Zero to Aware
seasons.purpose: Build the base mental model: what AI is, how an LLM produces text, and why it is powerful but fallible.
seasons.transformation: From 'I don't really understand AI' to 'I can explain what an LLM is, what a token and context window are, and why it hallucinates.'

seasons.name: Talk to AI Like a Pro
seasons.purpose: Turn a passive user into a skilled, responsible user: prompting, verification, privacy, judgment.
seasons.transformation: From 'I type and hope' to 'I deliberately give task, context and constraints, check the output, and know when not to use AI.'

seasons.name: Meet the Models
seasons.purpose: Understand modern models as products with trade-offs: families, speed/intelligence/cost, multimodality, system prompts, reasoning, guardrails.
seasons.transformation: From 'AI is one thing' to 'Models differ, and choosing one is an engineering decision.'

seasons.name: How AI Apps Actually Work
seasons.purpose: Cross from user to builder: client/server, APIs, JSON, tools, grounding, RAG, embeddings, and production app architecture.
seasons.transformation: From 'AI is a chat window' to 'An AI app is a model plus code, data and tools, and I can read an architecture diagram.'

seasons.name: Agents Without the Magic
seasons.purpose: Demystify agents as a loop of model + tools + observations, and teach when (and when not) to use them.
seasons.transformation: From 'agents are magic' to 'I understand the loop, its failure modes, and when a simple workflow is better.'

seasons.name: MCP and Skills
seasons.purpose: Explain the integration problem MCP addresses, its real architecture and security boundaries, and how Agent Skills differ from tools.
seasons.transformation: From 'MCP is a buzzword' to 'I can say what MCP is, what it is not, and how it relates to APIs, tools, agents and skills.'

seasons.name: Claude Code and Coding Agents
seasons.purpose: Teach the minimum dev literacy (files, terminal, git) and then how a coding agent works responsibly.
seasons.transformation: From 'AI writes code somehow' to 'I understand how a coding agent works in a repo and why humans must review it.'

seasons.name: Reliable AI
seasons.purpose: Teach evaluation, security, observability and failure handling: the gap between demo and production.
seasons.transformation: From 'it worked in the demo' to 'I know how to test, secure, monitor and safely fail AI systems.'

seasons.name: From Idea to Real Project
seasons.purpose: Choose problems worth solving with AI and walk them through prototype, pilot, production and adoption.
seasons.transformation: From 'let's add AI' to 'I can frame a use case with a baseline, success criteria, users, risk and a rollout plan.'

seasons.name: Forward Deployed Engineering
seasons.purpose: Synthesize everything into the FDE way of working: customer problem to deployed, measured solution.
seasons.transformation: From 'I know the parts' to 'I can describe how an FDE would discover, design, validate, pilot and scale an AI solution.'

seasons.name: Capstone: The Bluebird Project
seasons.purpose: A connected fictional case study that shows every decision, including the decisions NOT to use RAG, agents, MCP or skills.
seasons.transformation: From 'I know the components' to 'I understand WHY each component exists, and why the simplest reliable architecture wins.'
